project.name: My Rust Application
project.description: A Rust application for managing local project data.

vision: Provide a reliable, testable, and maintainable application for managing local project data.
principles: Prefer simple designs over speculative abstractions.
Keep domain logic independent from infrastructure.
Make behavior observable through tests and diagnostics.
successCriteria: The application can create, read, update, and delete project records.
Core domain behavior is covered by automated tests.
The workspace passes formatting, checks, tests, and clippy.
constraints: The application must run on the supported target platforms.
External services must be accessed through replaceable interfaces.
No feature is considered complete without acceptance tests or an explicit justification.

dependencyRules: core must not depend on infrastructure
app may orchestrate core and infrastructure
infrastructure must expose interfaces suitable for testing

milestones.title: Minimum viable application
milestones.description: Deliver the smallest usable version of the application.

goals.title: Define the domain model
goals.description: Create the core types and rules for project records.
goals.value: Establishes the stable business concepts used by the rest of the application.
acceptanceCriteria: Core entities and identifiers are defined.
Unit tests cover the main rules.

risks.description: The model may become coupled to persistence concerns.

backlog.title: Add a web interface
backlog.description: Explore a browser-based interface after the CLI MVP.
backlog.reason: Not required for the current milestone.

decisions.title: Use a Cargo workspace
decisions.decision: Separate application, domain, and infrastructure concerns into workspace crates.
decisions.rationale: This supports testability and keeps dependencies directional.
